results.title: ‘Put the Guns Down’: Community prayer rally set for Nov. 15
results.description: Community advocates and local faith leaders will gather on the court square in downtown Newnan this weekend for a prayer rally aimed at addressing gun violence in Coweta County.

results.title: Trump Comments on Jensen Huang Resignation Amid Spy Scandal
results.description: Donald Trump discusses former NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's resignation following allegations of an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, highlighting national security concerns.
